guidance: Will it be INR200, 500, 1000 crores revenue company or any ROCE, IRR guidance, something in quantitative terms, if you could mention?
We expect that the next year, FY 2028, we should be doing at least INR150 crores to start within the next year, with respect to these machines.
capex: During the quarter, we have recognized an exceptional gain of INR50 crores from slump sale to ACE KATO Private Limited, which led to PAT expansion by 597 basis points to 17.62% at INR164.3 crores.
Our current capacity that we have, we can easily go up to INR5,500 crores of revenue, maybe slightly more than this figure, because our plant line will also get commissioned soon.
risks: During the quarter, the global macroeconomic environment remained challenging, shaped by geopolitical uncertainties and persistent inflationary pressures across key commodities, resulting in elevated raw material costs.
Despite these external headwinds, the underlying fundamentals of the Indian economy remain strong.
focus: At ACE, we have continued to leverage our core strengths, operational capabilities, and market presence to navigate an evolving business environment while maintaining our focus on sustainable and profitable growth.
We achieved this through highly disciplined commercial execution and focusing on our strengths.
We remain focused on strengthening our product mix through the introduction of higher capacity, technologically advanced, and application-specific equipment.

about: Action Construction Equipment Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing and marketing of hydraulic mobile cranes, mobile tower cranes, material handling equipment like forklifts, road construction equipment like backhoe loaders, compactors, motor graders and agriculture equipment like tractors, harvesters, rotavators, etc. It was incorporated in 1995 and concluded its IPO in 2006.
